title_original: 지역농림어업 발전사업 협력 촉진에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rules of the Act on Facilitation of Cooperation in Local Agriculture and Fisheries Development Projects [Attached Table]

Requirements for Dedicated Personnel of Evaluating Agencies (Related to Article 4, subparagraph 2)

1. A person who holds a doctoral degree and has at least two years of experience in performing performance measurement and evaluation duties or research related to performance measurement and evaluation, including experience acquired before obtaining the degree.

2. A person who holds a master's degree and has at least four years of experience in performing performance measurement and evaluation duties or related research, including experience acquired before obtaining the degree.

3. A person who holds an associate degree or bachelor's degree and has at least six years of experience in performing performance measurement and evaluation duties or related research, including experience acquired before obtaining the degree.

4. A person who has graduated from high school (including a person whose academic attainment is recognized under other statutes or regulations as equivalent to high school graduation; hereinafter the same shall apply) and has at least eight years of experience in performing performance measurement and evaluation duties or related research, including experience acquired before graduation.
